claim: In Gravesend's pawn shop (2026-11-18) a barred strongroom in the back wall (a recess a quarter of a body up under a ceiling half a body lower, a blocking masked grille in the owner's grate 463, a lit room behind) read to a blind reviewer as a jail cell until goods stood inside it; then it was 'a shop's secure stock'. It was a detail, not depth: the shop's floor heights (5 and 5) and shade spread (17 and 18) hardly moved and the city's medians per interior did not; and a cage nothing meets and nobody can open read as decoration.
evidence: projects/blood-city/experiments/pledge-room/README.md and measurements.txt (2026-11-18): the pawn shop before and after: floor heights 5 and 5, ceiling heights 3 and 4, wall tiles 10 and 13, shade spread 17 and 18 (tools/city_profile.py --interiors); critic.md, five unlabelled sets, what-if.png
use: Build it with bloodmap.glass.grille and stock it; piercing a wall changes which wall is the longest solid one, so anything placed by that rule (the shop's sign) moves.
